entities.name: A0PSI5
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference identifies this exact 731-aa sequence as malate synthase G from Mycobacterium ulcerans Agy99.
Catalyzes acetyl-CoA + glyoxylate to form malate and CoA; annotated magnesium ion binding.
Reference annotation places it in the cytoplasm and associates it with glyoxylate catabolism and the glyoxylate cycle.

entities.name: Glyoxylate cycle
observations: Malate synthase catalyzes the glyoxylate-cycle step forming malate from acetyl-CoA and glyoxylate.

entities.name: Cytoplasm
observations: The exact-match reference protein is annotated as cytoplasmic; GO annotations also include cytosol.
